descFull: Stream your gaming PC to any browser with ultra-low latency. Built-in, highly optimized capture & encode engine with its own virtual display. Also works with existing hosts such as Sunshine, Apollo and Games on Whales (Wolf). Up to 4K HDR 240 fps, under 20 ms over Wi-Fi. Gamepads, racing wheels, flight sticks and RC radios.
